sourceNote: Every staged row's card number, player name, rung name and print run was read directly off baseballcardpedia.com. checklistinsider.com was consulted only for reconnaissance (confirming the product exists and its prefix) -- its rendered page did not surface this section's own card list, and no staged row's text came from it.

verbatimParallelsSentence: NOTE: The following inserts are available in the following parallels: 1990 Topps Baseball, 2024 All-Topps Team, 2024's Greatest Hits, Training Ground, Call to the Hall, 2024 First Pitch. Pink (limited, but not serial-numbered, to 600 copies) Blue (serial-numbered to 150 copies) Green (serial-numbered to 99 copies) Gold (serial-numbered to 50 copies) Orange (serial-numbered to 25 copies) Black (serial-numbered to ten) Red (serial-numbered to five) FoilFractor (one-of-one)
rowCount_check: 15 cards x 9 rungs (blank base + Pink + Blue + Green + Gold + Orange + Black + Red + FoilFractor) = 135 rows scraped.

absenceCheck.correctionNote: PR #2433 review (2026-09-26) found this package's FIRST absence pass wrong for the same reason as the CTH package in this PR: it hardcoded printRun=null when computing the id to point-read, for EVERY row, so every numbered parallel rung (including FoilFractor/1) was checked at the wrong id and 404'd unconditionally. The first pass wrongly staged all 10 FP- (Series One) FoilFractor rows as absent -- they are in fact checklist-present (source=checklistinsider-2026-08-27). Re-verified with backend/scripts/verify-absent.cjs (printRun read from the CSV row, no null fallback): 25 of 135 rows are checklist-present (10 FP- base + 10 FP- FoilFractor + 5 FP2- base); 110 are genuinely absent under setKey=topps.
absenceCheck.method: backend/scripts/verify-absent.cjs -- id via computeHobbyIqCardId from backend/dist, point-read card_catalog (pk=/cardId + None-partition shape), read-only Cosmos.
absenceCheck.note: The verifierOutput above is the run against the FINAL, already-trimmed 105-row CSV -- it confirms 0 present, 105 absent. Full accounting against the original 135-row scrape: 15 base rows present + 10 FP- FoilFractor rows present + 5 FP2- FoilFractor rows sibling-twinned under topps-series-2 (see below) + 105 staged = 135.

siblingRungTwinsExcluded.detail: FP2-1 FoilFractor through FP2-5 FoilFractor (all 5 Series Two First Pitch FoilFractor rows) are already checklist-present under setKey=topps-series-2, source=checklistinsider-2026-08-27, at ids like hiq:baseball:2025:topps-series-2:fp2-1:foilfractor:no-auto:num-1 -- re-verified directly by point-read at the corrected id -- same cardNumber, same rung, same player, checklist authority. These 5 rows are EXCLUDED from the staged CSV (spelling/address twin under a sibling setKey, not a genuine gap). No FP- (Series One) row produced a sibling-key twin; the 10 FP- FoilFractor rows are excluded because they are present under `topps` itself (see absenceCheck above), not because of a twin.

ownerRuling: FP-/FP2- lives under `topps` (no separate key); FoilFractor rungs on the FP2- cards are addressed under topps-series-2 already and are not restaged here.
